errors.text_span: като стойностите са разположени на интервали от 1
errors.evidence: The y-axis has visible tick marks at 0, 5, and 10, meaning the intervals are 5, not 1.
The value for rating 1 in the "Строител/Изпълнител" category is described as being around 9, but the bar clearly extends above the 10 mark on the y-axis, to approximately 12.

errors.text_span: За категорията „Проектант“, стълбовете за степен 1 и степен 2 също са по-високи
errors.evidence: For the "Проектант" category, the description incorrectly states that bars for ratings 1 and 2 are higher. In the chart, the highest bars are for ratings 2 (red, value ~9) and 3 (orange, value ~6), while the bar for rating 1 (blue) is one of the lowest (value ~2).

The description fails to explain the meaning of the rating scale, which is explicitly stated in the chart's title: 1 means 'most responsible' and 4 means 'least responsible'. This context is essential for understanding the data.

errors.text_span: Категориите „Клиент/Възложител“ и „Консултант“ показват по-равномерно разпределение на отговорите между четирите степени на отговорност, като стълбовете са с приблизително еднаква височина.
errors.evidence: This statement is a significant over-generalization. For the "Консултант" category in particular, the bar heights are not approximately equal; the highest bars (ratings 2 and 4, value ~7) are more than twice the height of the lowest bar (rating 3, value ~3), indicating a very uneven distribution.
The description omits the total number of survey respondents (105 responses), which is mentioned in the top-left corner of the chart.
